raw.thesis: Narma is positioned as an "Enterprise Agentic Brain" for AI-first companies, aiming to solve the critical problem of scaling AI automation. The core innovation lies in its three-layered architecture: observing work patterns via desktop sensors, an intelligence layer to detect intent and value, and an execution layer that automatically generates and deploys AI agents. This system focuses on leveraging existing foundation models, specifically analyzing the "Work Graph" to identify inefficiencies and opportunities for AI intervention. The venture targets AI-first companies struggling with quantifying AI savings, unreliable ROI measurements, and the continuous drift in systems and human resources. By providing a single system that observes, decides, and continuously builds AI agents, Narma aims to deliver "Continuous AI lift." This venture is currently at the idea stage, with the goal of building a growth startup that fundamentally changes how AI automation is implemented and scaled within enterprises. It seeks to replace the current fragmented and opaque methods of AI deployment with a unified, intelligent, and automated approach.
raw.product_description: Narma is a three-layered system designed to enable AI-first companies to scale AI automation. Layer 1 (Observe) uses lightweight desktop sensors to capture work patterns, including application usage, activity sequences, and time allocation. Layer 2 (Intelligence Layer) acts as a "Brain" to detect employee intent, assess the business value of tasks, and identify "drift" where work deviates from intended flows. Layer 3 (Execution Layer) is an "Agent Factory" that automatically generates, deploys, and monitors AI agents for high-ROI opportunities, complete with built-in approval gates. The system leverages existing foundation models and focuses on analyzing the "Work Graph" to pinpoint where resources are consumed and where AI can provide real-time assistance. Its vision is to create a single system that continuously observes work, decides on AI actions, and automatically builds agents to ensure a "Continuous AI lift."
raw.what_makes_this_different: Narma's distinction lies in its holistic, three-layered architecture that observes work patterns, detects employee intent and business value, and then automatically generates and deploys AI agents via an "Agent Factory." Its focus on the "Work Graph" and leveraging existing foundation models, rather than building new LLMs, allows it to pinpoint high-ROI opportunities and ensure "Continuous AI lift" with built-in approval gates.
